# Config files

Every file termocode reads or writes. termocode never fails to start because of a missing or broken file; it uses defaults instead.

## Config folder

`~/.config/termocode/`, or `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/termocode/`.

| File | Purpose | Format | Safe to edit? |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `config.json` | Settings (theme, editor, search, AI). See the settings reference. | JSON object. Unknown keys are kept on save. | Yes. Also Preferences: Open Settings (UI). |
| `keymap.json` | Key binding overrides. See the keys reference. | JSON object: key string → action name, or `"ext:<command id>"` for an extension command. | Yes. Also Preferences: Customize Keybindings. |
| `commands.json` | User commands shown in the palette as `User: <title>`. | JSON array of `{"id", "title", "cmd", "cwd"}`. | Yes. Open with Open Config: User Commands. |
| `snippets.json` | User snippets, layered over the built-in ones. | JSON object: scope (filetype or `*`) → trigger → body (string or array of lines). | Yes. Also Snippets: Manage…. |
| `user_theme.json` | Custom color theme saved by the theme editor. | JSON object: palette key (for example `BgEditor`) → hex color. Used by the `custom` theme. | Yes, but Preferences: Edit Custom Theme is easier. |
| `breakpoints.json` | Saved debugger breakpoints per file (line and line text). | JSON `{"version", "breakpoints": {file: [...]}}`. | Not needed. termocode rewrites it when breakpoints change. |
| `session.json` | Open files, tab order, cursor positions, expanded folders, workspace roots. | JSON, written by termocode. | No (state). Developer: Reset Session clears it and keeps `session.json.bak`. |
| `recents.json` | Recent files for the welcome screen and File: Open Recent…. | JSON array. | No (state). Safe to delete. |
| `workspaces.json` | Recent workspace folders for File: Open Recent Workspace…. | JSON array. | No (state). Safe to delete. |
| `palette_recents.json` | Recently used palette commands (shown first). | JSON array of command IDs. | No (state). Safe to delete. |
| `errors.log` | Log of error and warning toasts. `tail -f` it while debugging. | Plain text, one timestamped line per entry; secrets are redacted. | Safe to delete. |
| `settings-backup-<time>.json` | Backup written before Preferences: Import Settings…. | Settings bundle (same shape as an export). | Safe to delete. |
| `extensions/<name>/` | Lua extensions: `extension.json` manifest and `init.lua`. | Folder per extension. | Yes. Extensions: New Extension… creates one. |
| `ai/credentials.json` | AI API keys and Claude OAuth tokens. File mode 0600. | JSON `{"keys": {provider: key}, "claude_oauth": {...}}`. | With care. Prefer AI: Configure Provider…. Never exported by Preferences: Export Settings…. |
| `ai/chats/*.json` | Saved AI chats (newest 50 kept). | JSON, one file per chat. | Safe to delete. |

## Data folder

`~/.local/share/termocode/`, or `$XDG_DATA_HOME/termocode/`.

| File | Purpose | Format | Safe to edit? |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `plugins/` | Neovim plugins cloned on first launch (nvim-dap, vim-visual-multi). | Git checkouts. `$TERMOCODE_PLUGINS_DIR` moves it. | Delete to re-clone on next launch. |
| `tools/` | Language servers and debug adapters installed by LSP: Manage Language Servers… and DAP: Install Adapter…. | One folder per tool; `tools/bin` holds shims on Neovim's PATH. `$TERMOCODE_TOOLS_DIR` moves it. | Use the palette commands. Delete a tool folder to remove it. |
| `tools/asked.json` | Filetypes already asked about in the "no language server" toast. | JSON `{"filetypes": [...]}`. | Safe to delete (the toasts come back). |

## Workspace folder

Inside the folder you open.

| File | Purpose | Format | Safe to edit? |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `.termocode/tasks.json` | Workspace tasks for Tasks: Run Task…. | VS Code style tasks: `label`, `command`, `args`, `cwd`, `env`, `group`, `problemMatcher`. | Yes. Tasks: Configure Tasks creates it. |
| `.termocode/launch.json` | Debug and run configurations. | VS Code `launch.json` shape; comments allowed. | Yes. Debug: Open launch.json creates it. |
| `.editorconfig` | Indent and whitespace rules, read by Neovim's EditorConfig support. | EditorConfig INI. | Yes (read only for termocode). |

## Other files

| File | Purpose | Format | Safe to edit? |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `~/termocode-settings.json` | Default target of Preferences: Export Settings…. | Settings bundle: `{"termocode_settings": 1, "files": {...}}`. State files and secrets are left out. | Yes, but re-export is easier. |
| `~/.local/share/fonts/JetBrainsMonoNF/` | Nerd Font installed by `termocode setup` (Linux). | Font files. | Safe to delete. |

**Preferences: Export Settings…** writes all config-folder JSON files into one bundle, except state files (`session.json`, `recents.json`, `workspaces.json`, `palette_recents.json`) and anything that looks like a secret.
